hook: The last blown Falcon vs the blown Clubsport. Same dragstrip, same day. $21k apart.

stories.a: Ford's last hurrah. 10 seconds of overboost lifts it to 400 kW and 650 Nm, and it cost $21k less.
stories.b: Big 6.2 LSA with 400 kW all day, no timer. Quicker on MOTOR's strip by over half a second.
stories.take: The LSA wins the strip. The Sprint wins the wallet.

_sources: MOTOR/WhichCar 'Ford Falcon XR8 Sprint v HSV Clubsport R8 LSA' (whichcar.com.au and motormag.com.au): XR8 Sprint 4951cc supercharged V8, 345 kW (400 kW overboost), 575 Nm (650 Nm overboost), 1872 kg, $62,190, tested 5.07 s 0-100; Clubsport R8 LSA 6162cc supercharged LSA V8, 400 kW, 671 Nm, 1907 kg, $83,490 auto, tested 4.48 s 0-100; quarter mile tested 13.14 s (Sprint) vs 12.55 s (LSA)
